This API searches for the events in your help desk portal.
You can provide multiple values separated by commas, and the search will be performed on the field using any of the provided values.

Learn more about search and how it works.

info.name: Search Records by Criteria, Word, Email, or Phone

params.name: module
params.description: The API name of the CRM module to search within.

params.name: approval_state
params.description: Filter records by their approval status. This parameter is particularly useful for modules with approval workflows or data validation processes.

params.name: criteria
params.description:
Complex query string to search for records using field-specific conditions and operators. Supports up to 15 conditions combined with AND/OR operators. **Format:** `(field_name:operator:value)` with logical operators.
*Mandatory if email, phone, and word are not present.*

params.name: converted
params.description: Filter records by their conversion status. Primarily used with Leads module to distinguish between converted and non-converted leads. Also applicable to other modules with conversion workflows.

params.name: word
params.description:
A simple word or phrase to search across all supported text fields in the module. Performs a global search with minimum 2 characters required. This is the broadest search method but may be slower than specific field searches.
*Mandatory if criteria, email, and phone are not present.*

params.name: email
params.description:
Search records by email address across all email fields in the module. Supports partial matches and searches multiple email fields simultaneously.
*Mandatory if criteria, phone, and word are not present.*

params.name: phone
params.description:
Search records by phone number across all phone fields in the module. Supports various phone number formats including international, national, and partial numbers.
*Mandatory if criteria, email, and word are not present.*

params.name: fields
params.description: Comma-separated list of field API names to retrieve in the response. If not specified, all accessible fields are returned. Use this to optimize response size and improve performance.

params.name: page
params.description: The page number to retrieve for paginated results. Use in combination with per_page to navigate through large result sets.

params.name: per_page
params.description: The number of records to return per page. Higher values reduce the number of API calls needed but increase response size and processing time.

params.name: sort_by
params.description: The field API name to sort the search results by. Choose a field that exists in the target module for consistent sorting behavior.

params.name: sort_order
params.description: The sorting direction for the results. Use 'asc' for ascending (A-Z, 1-9, oldest first) or 'desc' for descending (Z-A, 9-1, newest first).

params.name: type
params.description: Filter users by their status, role, or confirmation state

items.docs: Searches records matching your criteria within a CRM module. Supports criteria queries, email/phone/word searches. At least one search parameter required. Max 2,000 records, 15 criteria conditions. Newly created records may have indexing delays.
